identity: A Vherathi communal hall from the front: one grown resin mass, its roofline rising higher and sharper on the left than the right, with a recessed entry and an off-center cluster of windows following the tallest ridge rather than a symmetric grid.
units: absolute local units (31 = player height). ELEVATION: x is facade width about 0, y<=0 is height above the floor.
scale_note: ~2.7x PLAYER_H tall at its peak, ~3.7x wide

silhouette.note: grown wall mass, asymmetric roofline (left taller/sharper)

details.note: vein trace along the tallest ridge
window cluster, biased left toward the tall ridge
second, smaller window, off-set from the first
